paper_title: An elementary proof of anti-concentration for degree two non-negative Gaussian polynomials
text:
\begin{lemma}[Small-ball bound for a noncentered Gaussian]
Let $x\sim N(\mu,\sigma^2)$, where $\mu\in\mathbb{R}$ and $\sigma>0$.
For every $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$,
\[
\mathbb{P}\!\left(\lvert x\rvert\leq
\varepsilon\lvert\mu\rvert\right)\leq\frac{\varepsilon}{2}.
\]
\end{lemma}
